# exo_availability_config (Data Source)

Look up an existing AvailabilityConfig object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_tenant_ids` (String) Maps to the -AllowedTenantIds parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `org_wide_account` (String) Maps to the -OrgWideAccount parameter.
